attributes.bullet_text: This unit provides a leadership bonus to nearby allies. Units within range of both the Lord's aura and an encouraging unit will receive the larger of the two bonuses.
This unit can hide in forests until enemy units get too close.

factionEffects.localised_description: Clan Lianllach bows to no prince. Since the fall of its last chief, the clan has been governed by a Council of Wavemasters, whose merchants, mages and admirals vie endlessly for the right to steer its fleets. What unites them is a reputation feared from Nippon to the New World: no one drives a harder bargain than Lianllach.

effects.description: When a trade agreement is signed, the Council decides its terms: fair, harsh, or with a hidden clause.
No single lord rules the clan. The Council of Wavemasters elects a new First Wavemaster at regular intervals.
Send trade convoys across the world via the Gilded Route and navigate risks en route to reap great financial rewards

backgroundSkills.localised_description: No single Elf commands Clan Lianllach. The Council elects its leaders, and the clan follows the tide.

effects.description: Faction-wide effects are determined by the result of each Council election.
